text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday. I just sent... your 
present to your phone."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, thank you so much!\nSo it's this 
email, right—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
An e-ticket for the play...! I absolutely 
love this production! It makes you laugh, 
it makes you cry, and the ending is so 
refreshing♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...You've already—seen it before? Sorry... 
I should have picked a different film.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is what I want. It makes me the 
happiest! To think I can watch all those 
famous scenes again."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the stage is a living thing. 
The acting and staging constantly grow and 
evolve. I'm sure it's changed even since 
the time I saw it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, it really is true! Every time you 
watch a live theatrical performance, you 
discover something new—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad I got to see it. Your... happy 
face.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I hope my feelings reach you properly.
